title: Standing work: iron and copper at Hamal Crystal Bloom into storage at Node Beta (S6)
note: Standing work (Suggi, 2026-11-16: no ship is idle; a ship without paying work levels and gathers). Written 2026-11-16 14:51 UTC by Unity from the census of 14:3x UTC: the field read iron ore 100,000 of 100,000 and copper ore 100,000 of 100,000, full. Nothing is sold: the load goes into the pilot's storage at Node Beta, the iron and copper of standing order S6. Not judged on its pay (its fuel is its price; the first ore routes measured about -160 cr per ship-hour). `min_left` closes it when a census reads the field under 40,000 of either ore and opens it again when the field has grown back; what the field grows back per hour is not measured yet.
